description: Product Description Lumin One Near Zero EMF Far Infrared Sauna Create your own personal wellness sanctuary with the Lumin One Near Zero EMF Far Infrared Sauna , a beautifully crafted 1–2 person infrared sauna designed to bring the therapeutic benefits of infrared heat into your home. Built from premium Canadian Hemlock , this elegant sauna combines natural beauty, energy-efficient performance, and modern convenience in a compact footprint ideal for bedrooms, home gyms, wellness rooms, and private relaxation spaces. The Lumin One utilizes advanced Far Infrared Heating Technology to deliver deep-penetrating warmth that gently heats the body from within. Unlike traditional saunas that primarily heat the surrounding air, far infrared heat promotes a more comfortable experience while supporting relaxation, comfort, and post-activity recovery while creating a soothing spa-quality environment at home. Designed for daily wellness routines, the Lumin One features Near Zero EMF technology (under 3MG) , allowing you to enjoy infrared therapy with confidence. The carefully crafted Canadian Hemlock interior creates a warm and inviting atmosphere while offering excellent durability and resistance to everyday use. A modern digital computer control panel makes it easy to customize temperature and session settings, allowing you to tailor every sauna experience to your personal wellness goals. With flexible 110V/220V electrical compatibility , installation is simple and convenient for most residential environments. Whether you are seeking stress relief, post-workout recovery, improved relaxation, or a dedicated space to unwind after a long day, the Lumin One delivers professional-quality infrared therapy in a stylish and space-efficient design.
